implement: legion-worker: pr-body.md for the proof lines and the simplify pass, tools.md for the PostgreSQL and Playwright the proofs need, cleanup-deletion.md for removing the handoff-push machinery and skip-checks-trailer.md
dispatch: the new handoff-write/handoff-read commands follow the spec-built Dispatch CLI and its write conventions, and the worker texts teach them
ce-simplify-code: the simplify pass pr-body.md requires on the settled change
test: legion-worker: pr-body.md defines the tester's proof, its negative control and what CI covers instead of the tester; tools.md for running the Dispatch browser suite and the live proofs in the pod
dispatch: the tester reads and writes handoffs with dispatch handoff-read/handoff-write and checks the Conversation entry
review: legion-worker: merge-gate.md (the approved head is now the code head, READY's narrowed .legion/ allowance), review-threads.md, cleanup-deletion.md for checking nothing of the removed machinery is left
dispatch: judging the new Dispatch routes, event and CLI against the existing Dispatch conventions

findings.finding: A root whose code all lands through its children has no commit after the cutover, so GitHub opens no pull request and implementing never ends (engine.go:519-522).
findings.answer: D13: the root's implementer pushes one empty commit with no trailer; P7 proves on sjawhar/legion-smoke that GitHub opens and checks it first; if GitHub refuses, the implementer reports to the architect. Listed as an open point.

findings.finding: In-flight branches whose head is a skip-checks handoff push never get required checks once the carry is gone.
findings.answer: Spec v6 design 9 and D11: the import pushes one removal commit with no trailer to every branch carrying .legion/, so each head runs its checks; P5 and P7 prove it, the production check reads it (A9).

findings.finding: With READY_HEAD_CARRIES_HANDOFFS and retro's removal gone, in-flight .legion/ files merge, or READY_UNREVIEWED_CHANGE sends issues back.
findings.answer: Spec v6 design 9 keeps READY accepting the removal above the approved head; D10 narrows it to files GitHub lists as removed under .legion/, so nothing can add one; P5 covers both.

findings.finding: The import could write above records workers wrote since.
findings.answer: D11: it writes only when the newest record is absent or its own and differs from the file, never above a worker's; a second run writes nothing (P5).

findings.finding: Imported records break HANDOFF_NOT_NEW and the session check; 'with no session' is impossible.
findings.answer: D9/D11: imported records are under the daemon's session legion-daemon:<PROJECT>, so a completion naming one is refused HANDOFF_SESSION_MISMATCH with a message to re-write it under the worker's session (P1 A7 step); HANDOFF_NOT_NEW keys on record id. Spec departure 2.

findings.finding: Import timing: a role could start before its issue's import.
findings.answer: D11 run order: import runs while the old daemon still runs, before the rollout, and again after it; old daemon workers keep reading branch files until then.

findings.finding: Reporting @- for every phase departs from 'instead of a commit' and adds a refusal.
findings.answer: D8: only the implementer reports a commit (the pushed tip, refused when @- is unpushed), retro and merger as today; planner, tester and reviewer report the record only. Spec departure 6.

findings.finding: claims.session may differ from the CLI's session (Claude ENVOY_SESSION_ID override, session switch).
findings.answer: D5: the CLI under claude uses ENVOY_SESSION_ID ?? CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID as claude-envoy's claim does; the mismatch refusal names both sessions; A3 drives the daemon route directly (P1); the pane does no session check (D8).

findings.finding: Root lines 255 and 258 lack issue checks; A3 lacks a positive control.
findings.answer: Spec v6 added A10 and A9; P1 covers A3 with its positive control, A10 and the import refusal; section 4 maps root lines 255-258.

findings.finding: A2 and A8 cannot be proven pre-merge from a pod.
findings.answer: Section 4: P1 and P7 are the pre-merge halves; A2 and A8's real-agent run is the production check and INFRA-480; stage4b's updated assertion is operator-run and not claimed.

findings.finding: A4 is not machine-decidable as written.
findings.answer: P3 gives the exact git grep with each exclusion and its reason (history, captured GitHub testdata, Envoy's CI store describing GitHub's own trailer).

findings.finding: A1's negative control depends on commit split.
findings.answer: D7 and steps 4-5: the Activity/event/SSE commit lands before the Conversation commit; P2 runs the spec against both builds.

findings.finding: 'Every push now counts as a fix attempt' does not match the code.
findings.answer: D10: the tester's review-App pushes keep their exceptions; spec departure 5.

findings.finding: Stored pushes JSON keeps handoffOnly.
findings.answer: D10: json.Unmarshal drops the key and nothing reads it after the carry goes; no data migration. Migration 0055's rollback is documented (step 6).

findings.finding: Deploy order and a boot refusal.
findings.answer: D11 run order documented; D14: no boot refusal, since the import fails first on a Dispatch without the routes and completions name Dispatch's 404.

findings.finding: Generated copies, contract versions, fixtures and live scripts that must change.
findings.answer: Steps 1-13 name each: contract 40 and its pins and fixtures, claude-envoy rebuild, Dispatch migration 0120, route pin, event lists, seed.ts, classifyPush and reduceGithubEvent fixtures, stage3/stage4b/claude-backend-tmux/lib scripts (checked with bash -n, run by the operator).

findings.finding: dispatch handoff write|read cannot parse.
findings.answer: D5: handoff-write and handoff-read; spec departure 1.

findings.finding: Dropping phase/issue/completed from bodies is unrequested.
findings.answer: D6: body shape unchanged; completed is INFRA-336's.

findings.finding: workspace-recovered.json is stale in the spec.
findings.answer: Spec departure 4; the LEGION_WORKSPACE_RECREATED notice points at the record (step 7).

findings.finding: Unsupported claims (38 KB, citations, INFRA-149 order, INFRA-157).
findings.answer: Cap set at 256 KiB, well above; citations refreshed to main; INFRA-149 is done and this issue removes its rules; no AskGate code exists, so nothing to exempt (open points).

findings.finding: The {phase} key and event delivery are ambiguous.
findings.answer: D1: the handoff word; D4: handoff.recorded carries id/phase/version, no body, no human notification, ignored by the daemon.

specDepartures.spec: Design 3: `dispatch handoff write|read` calls the routes.
specDepartures.plan: The commands are `dispatch handoff-write` and `dispatch handoff-read`.
specDepartures.evidence: The CLI takes one word as its command: packages/envoy-client/src/dispatch-command.ts:289-300.

specDepartures.spec: Design 9: the import writes version 1 of each record 'with no session'.
specDepartures.plan: The import writes under the daemon's Dispatch session legion-daemon:<PROJECT>, which the completion's session check then refuses as another session's.
specDepartures.evidence: Dispatch refuses a bearer write that names no session actor (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/server.go:684-704); the daemon already writes as DaemonSession (packages/daemon/internal/dispatch/client.go:309-316).

specDepartures.spec: Design 9: a one-time command, run before the release rolls out, writes version 1.
specDepartures.plan: The same command also runs once after the rollout, writing a later version only above its own earlier record and never above a worker's.
specDepartures.evidence: Between the first run and the rollout, workers on the old release can still push new .legion/ files; a second run catches them.

specDepartures.plan: No such file is kept; the LEGION_WORKSPACE_RECREATED notice points at the Dispatch record.
specDepartures.evidence: Nothing writes the file since daemon contract 37 (packages/daemon/internal/api/version.go:314-316).

specDepartures.spec: Design 6: every push now counts as a fix attempt.
specDepartures.plan: Only handoff-only pushes lose their exception; the tester's red-test pushes by the review App stay uncounted and keep the planned-red mark.
specDepartures.evidence: packages/daemon/internal/classify/decisions.go:31,146-155 exempt ByReviewApp pushes separately from handoff-only ones.

outcome.scope: Design 6's fix-attempt sentence is narrowed to handoff-only pushes; the tester's planned-red pushes are unchanged.

specDepartures.spec: Design 5 (and the parent spec): handoff_complete reports the record id and version, naming the record instead of a commit.
specDepartures.plan: The implementer also reports its pushed tip; retro and the merger keep reporting @-.
specDepartures.evidence: implementationReady applies the CI rule only when the pull request's head equals the implementer's reported commit (packages/daemon/internal/workflow/review.go:520); the merger's commit is READY's head (workflow/ready.go).
